The Device Builder holds every device you use: nodes, splitters, switches, panels, cables and racks. You open it from the Nodes and Splitters page.
Click Device Builder. Every kind of device has its own tab. Let's make a new node.
Give it a brand and a name, the number of DMX ports, and one or two Ethernet ports.
The short name is used in racks and overviews, so a long name is never cut off. Leave it empty, and PatchLab makes one for you.
On top, the preview shows the front of the device as it will look in a rack. Click Save node.
The new node is in the list, and in your own library, so it is there in every project. The same goes for splitters, switches and panels.
The button Fill short names, at the bottom, gives all your existing devices a short name at once, so you can adjust them afterwards.
